conflict_plugin_warn: Conflict plugin detected: siyuan-plugin-toolbar-plus, multi-line breadcrumb mode may be affected
setting_oneLineBreadcrumb_desp: Display the breadcrumb on the same line as SiYuan's native block breadcrumb. Not recommended: this relies on the native breadcrumb's DOM structure and flex layout. A SiYuan update, or a conflict with another plugin, may cause misalignment, squeezing, or failure.
setting_hideNativeBreadcrumb_desp: Hide SiYuan's native block breadcrumb. Requires "Single Line Breadcrumb" to be enabled to take effect. Not recommended: SiYuan updates may change the breadcrumb's behavior and rendering, which can break this option or cause unexpected issues.
setting_usePluginArrow_desp: Use native arrow style `&g;` instead of theme custom `/` to ensure the arrows in breadcrumbs are clickable.
setting_icon_desp: Set icon display mode in breadcrumb
setting_breadcrumbNameMaxLength_desp: Maximum display width of a document name in the breadcrumb, in em. Set to 0 to keep the adaptive width. Only takes effect when the breadcrumb overflows and names need to be truncated.
setting_foldedFrontShow_desp: Number of items to keep visible at the front when folding
setting_foldedEndShow_desp: Number of items to keep visible at the end when folding
setting_immediatelyUpdate_desp: Listen to document change events for real-time breadcrumb update (uses cache)
setting_allowFloatWindow_desp: Allow previewing documents in breadcrumb via float window
setting_swapClickFunction_desp: Swap left/right click functions (left for menu, right for open)
setting_typeHide_desp: Hide breadcrumb on keydown, restore on mousemove
setting_showAdjacentDocButton_option_1_d: Navigate between docs under the same parent
setting_showAdjacentDocButton_option_2_d: Navigate between all docs at the same level (cross-level)
setting_simplifyAdjacentDocButton_desp: Show only direction labels (Previous/Next) without document names, with both buttons equal in width
setting_menuKeepCurrentVisible_desp: Auto-scroll to current document position when menu opens
setting_menuExtendSubDocDepth_desp: Maximum depth for expanding sub-documents in menu
setting_createDocBtnInMenu_desp: Show create new document button in related doc menu
setting_nameMaxLength_desp: Max characters shown for a document name in menus; the overflow is truncated with "...". Menus only - document names in the breadcrumb are not affected.
setting_notOnlyOpenDocs_desp: Insert breadcrumb for all protyles, not just opened documents
setting_preferOpenInCurrentSplit_desp: Prefer opening documents in current split when clicking breadcrumb items
setting_autoFixFocusError_desp: Automatically detect and fix document focus errors
setting_docMaxNum_desp: Maximum number of documents to show in menu

setting_settingIconTips_desp:
🔄 indicates that the meaning or effect of the setting has changed in the latest version. Please read the changelog(written in Chinese)to understand the changes and any necessary adjustments you may need to make.
🆕 indicates a newly added setting in the latest version. Please read the changelog(written in Chinese) to learn about the new feature.
🧪 or 🚧 indicates an experimental feature. The developer will make efforts to maintain it, but it may be removed if there are unresolvable issues.
🚅 indicates a feature in public beta testing. When a feature has passed a small-scale test, it will be marked as such (although there may not have been many testers, so its reliability is unknown).
⛔ indicates a legacy compatibility option that will be removed soon.
